	(function(){

		if(!btns.length)return;
		function loadSDK(){
			if(window._slSDK)return window._slSDK;
			window._slSDK=new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
				if(typeof Storylane!=='undefined'){resolve();return;}
				var s=document.createElement('script');
				s.src='https://js.storylane.io/js/v1/storylane.js';
				s.onload=resolve;
				s.onerror=reject;
				document.head.appendChild(s);
			});
			return window._slSDK;
		}
		function fixAlt(container){
			var imgs=container.querySelectorAll('img.sl-preview-img:not([alt])');
			for(var i=0;i<imgs.length;i++){imgs[i].setAttribute('alt','Storylane demo preview');}
		}
		btns.forEach(function(btn){
			btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
				var url=btn.getAttribute('data-demo-url');
				if(!url)return;
				btn.classList.add('sl-loading');
				btn.setAttribute('disabled','');
				loadSDK().then(function(){
					Storylane.Play({type:'preview_embed',demo_type:'image',width:2560,height:1442,element:btn,demo_url:url});
					btn.classList.remove('sl-loading');
					btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
					setTimeout(function(){fixAlt(btn.closest('.sl-embed-container')||document);},1000);
				}).catch(function(){
					btn.classList.remove('sl-loading');
					btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
					window.open(url,'_blank');
				});
			});
		});
	})();
	</script>

Request a demo Links that just work Deliver the best user experience with powerful marketing links that work on every platform and every channel. Learn more about deep linking Attribution for everything Attribute app actions to the campaigns that drove them across every channel, platform, and OS to optimize performance and maximize ROI. Learn more about attribution The partner regulated industries trust We don’t just support compliance — we’re built for it. Health, finance, and enterprise brands rely on us to drive mobile growth without the risk. Learn more about Advanced Compliance Use cases Guiding new or returning web visitors to your app Maximizing app install ad success Optimizing mobile reengagement ad campaigns Measuring CTV campaigns Delivering email readers directly to your app Measuring web SEO traffic to the app Enabling and measuring offline to app experiences Breaking out of walled gardens Reducing your cost to serve Guiding new or returning web visitors to your app Problem Your mobile website gets a lot of traffic, but it’s not optimized for conversions and engagement compared to your mobile app. Solution Convert casual web visitors into loyal app users with custom, targeted smart banners that carry context through install for a stellar first impression. If they land on your website in the future, smart banners seamlessly direct app them to the content they’re viewing in your mobile app. Learn how payoneer drove 204K installs Learn more about smart banners Maximizing app install ad success Problem You spend valuable ad dollars capturing new app users, but in today’s privacy-focused environment, it’s harder than ever to get useful, unbiased attribution data. Solution We not only provide accurate, deduplicated install attribution but also deliver users to specific content in your app post install, increasing their likelihood to convert. Learn how 6thStreet increased conversions from paid ads Learn more about Branch Performance Optimizing mobile reengagement ad campaigns Problem Reengaging existing users is critical to maximizing your user lifetime value (LTV), but privacy regulations can complicate the tracking and attribution of these efforts. Solution We help you build precise audience segments based on previous user behaviors and engagements. This allows you to target users with tailored reengagement campaigns and measure the impact with privacy-preserving attribution data. Learn more about audience building Measuring CTV campaigns Problem Users are spending more time on connected TV (CTV) devices and platforms than ever before, but marketers investing in CTV ads struggle to accurately understand their downstream conversion events, and few measurement solutions are suited for CTV’s unique challenges. Solution We make it effortless to track and attribute CTV ad performance to downstream engagements with accurate, unbiased measurement. It’s now easier to optimize and justify your CTV marketing budget with clear insights into holistic campaign effectiveness. Learn how A&E Networks optimized OTT campaign performance Learn more about household measurement Delivering email readers directly to your app Problem There are many edge cases to solve for when linking out of the email channel, and email click analytics alone won’t show you pivotal insights such as if someone purchases in-app days after clicking an email. Solution We solve linking on mobile. With extensive email service provider (ESP) integrations and a team deeply familiar with the challenges on mobile, we improve the email workflow, provide more contextual user experiences, increase email revenue, and provide new down-funnel attribution from email. Learn how Ancestry tripled its app engagement with Branch Learn more about Branch for email Measuring web SEO traffic to the app Problem Search engine optimization (SEO) teams spend countless hours optimizing search results. Enabling deep linking historically meant losing visibility into their efforts, missing key performance indicator (KPI) goals, and working around blind spots in their overall marketing strategy. Solution Our SEO App Attribution solution provides insight into app opens and down-funnel events coming from organic search traffic, helping marketers unlock the value and ROI of SEO in the context of mobile app engagement, improving decision-making across marketing channels. Learn more about SEO App Attribution Enabling and measuring offline to app experiences Problem Customers expect to be able to use your app at any stage of the customer journey, and you need a way to move your users from offline into your app. QR codes have taken off, but a lot of QR codes are not optimized for app engagement. Solution We make it easy to create custom, dynamic QR codes that align with your brand’s look and feel for a seamless user experience. Effortlessly manage routing destinations to keep campaigns fresh, and track downstream performance in one place to optimize acquisition, engagement, and ultimately LTV from offline, desktop, or over-the-top (OTT). Learn how KFC scaled QR codes across its restaurants Learn more about Branch’s QR code solution Breaking out of walled gardens Problem Social platforms load an in-app browser designed to keep app users in a walled version of their website. You’re missing out on driving engagement and conversions every time your users are stuck within a walled garden instead of on your native app. Solution Our branded short links can be scaled across social channels to take app users from content in a social post to the same content in your app (or after install for new users). With cross-channel analytics, you’ll unlock insight into organic social as an acquisition channel and attribute downstream events to the social campaign that drove them. Learn how RTLZWEI drove installs and engagement from social Reducing your cost to serve Problem You spent time, money, and resources building an awesome app, but high volumes of customer inquiries are still directed to costly support channels. Solution Branch links and QR codes guide users to your app to complete key actions. By redirecting users from expensive channels like phone support to more cost-effective self-service options in the app, Branch helps you lower operational costs while simultaneously delivering a great customer experience. <div class="schema-faq wp-block-yoast-faq-block"><div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402851251"><strong class="schema-faq-question">What is an MMP?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">A mobile measurement partner (MMP) helps you measure marketing impact across channels by attributing installs, opens, and downstream events to the campaigns and touchpoints that drove them.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402861167"><strong class="schema-faq-question">How does Branch attribution work?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Branch uses multiple attribution methods prioritized by accuracy to determine which marketing touchpoint influenced an install or app open, then ties downstream events back to that source so teams can optimize spend and outcomes. See the <a href="https://help.branch.io/marketer-hub/docs/branch-attribution-explained">Help Center overview</a> for more details.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402883160"><strong class="schema-faq-question">Does Branch support deep linking?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Yes. Branch deep links route users to the right in-app content or web destination, preserve context, and reduce drop-off when customers move between web, app, email, social, and ads. <a href="https://www.branch.io/deep-linking/" type="page" id="26703">Learn more</a>.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402893006"><strong class="schema-faq-question">Can Branch measure web, app, email, QR codes, and offline journeys?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Yes. Branch supports omnichannel linking and measurement across web to app, app to web, email, paid media, QR codes, and offline-to-online handoffs so teams can see the full journey. <a href="https://www.branch.io/products/activation/" type="page" id="26736">Learn more</a>.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402903671"><strong class="schema-faq-question">Does Branch support privacy-first measurement?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Branch supports modern privacy frameworks and measurement approaches to maintain coverage as platforms and regulations evolve. <a href="https://www.branch.io/security/" type="page" id="29928">See our security overview</a>.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402914127"><strong class="schema-faq-question">Can Branch help with CTV and TV-driven journeys?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Branch helps connect offline and TV-style moments to digital experiences through links and QR codes, making it easier to quantify downstream impact.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402924695"><strong class="schema-faq-question">How does Branch help with AI-powered discovery and agents?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Branch is built for emerging discovery surfaces by preserving context and measurement when traffic originates from AI-powered answers, assistants, and agents, including journeys where conversions may be completed by humans or machines.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402933738"><strong class="schema-faq-question">What integrations does Branch offer?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Branch works across a large partner ecosystem. <a href="https://www.branch.io/partners/all/" type="page" id="29915">Browse our partner directory</a>.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770402942990"><strong class="schema-faq-question">How secure is Branch?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Branch maintains enterprise-grade security and privacy practices designed for strict procurement and compliance environments, including:<br/><br/>– SOC 2-compliant infrastructure<br/>– GDPR- and CCPA-aligned data practices<br/>– Reliable links that persist across OS updates and device changes<br/>– Highly available global infrastructure with low latency<br/><br/><a href="https://www.branch.io/security/" type="page" id="29928">Learn more</a></p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770403052276"><strong class="schema-faq-question">Do I need an SDK to use Branch?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Some Branch capabilities require an SDK for in-app measurement, while others such as links, QR codes, and web journeys can be implemented without one.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770403061730"><strong class="schema-faq-question">Does Branch support SKAdNetwork and privacy-safe attribution?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Yes. Branch supports SKAdNetwork (SKAN) and privacy-safe measurement approaches designed for modern mobile ecosystems.</p> </div> <div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1770403071015"><strong class="schema-faq-question">What data can I export from Branch?</strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">Branch allows teams to export raw and aggregated data to analytics, BI, and warehouse tools for deeper analysis and reporting.</p> </div> </div>

https://www.branch.io/about/.visible_text: All About the Leader in Mobile Linking and Measurement | Branch Skip to content Products Left Column Engagement Increase conversions from owned and organic channels. Performance Improve ads ROI with sophisticated attribution. Activation Drive actions with branded short links and QR codes. Discovery Reach your users with targeted programmatic media buying. Right column Data Exports Get your data where and how you want it, on your schedule. Ivy Intelligence that accelerates growth. Banners Targeted web-to-app banners that convert browsers into buyers. Link Management Create, manage, and analyze links at scale Solutions Use Cases Deep Linking Attribution Advanced Compliance Industries Health Finance Retail & E-commerce Food & Beverage Media & Entertainment Travel Partners Partners Overview Learn Blogs Guides Glossary White Papers Webinars Podcasts Case Studies Events Branch University Maturity Assessment Help Center Pricing Login Request a demo About We’re Branch — nice to meet you We exist to power impactful experiences in the connected world. The way we do it? By delivering omnichannel linking and measurement solutions for flawless user journeys and comprehensive campaign insights. Request a demo The brand evolution Over the past year, Branch has fundamentally evolved, transforming our platform into a more intelligent, AI-powered solution built for how modern growth actually works. Our refreshed brand and experience reflect that shift, pairing a bold new look with smarter technology designed to connect journeys, surface the exact campaign insights you need when you need them, and help you move with purpose. This isn’t just a new identity — it’s a signal of the innovation, clarity, and momentum powering our next chapter. Take a fresh look and see what’s possible for your growth. Branch’s origins Branch started with a problem our founders lived firsthand. While building their own app, they ran into a frustrating reality: Acquiring users was hard — and even something as simple as linking to a special in-app offer kept breaking. That frustration sparked a simple question: Why hadn’t anyone solved mobile linking? So they did. What started as a fix for a broken journey became a platform for connected growth. Today, Branch powers reliable, seamless linking across any channel and has expanded into an industry-leading linking and measurement platform that helps brands understand what’s working, what’s not, and how every experience connects. Branch is your AI-powered MMP Growth happens across apps, web, email, paid media, social, connected TV (CTV), offline — and whatever channels emerge next. When those experiences aren’t connected, customers drop off, measurement breaks down, and marketing spend goes to waste. Branch’s AI-powered solutions help organizations guide customers into their brand experiences, engage and retain users, and save money by ensuring marketing dollars go to the right channels. Engagement Increase conversions from owned and organic channels Performance Improve ads ROI with sophisticated attribution Activation Drive action with branded links and QR codes Discovery Reach your users with targeted, programmatic media buying Explore the platform How Branch compares Branch vs. link shorteners Traditional link shorteners focus on redirects and clicks. Branch links preserve context, intelligently route users, and tie downstream actions back to the source so teams can measure real conversions. Branch vs. legacy MMPs Legacy mobile measurement partners (MMPs) focus primarily on mobile last-touch attribution. Branch measures full omnichannel journeys across web, app, offline, CTV, and AI-driven discovery. Branch vs. analytics-only tools Analytics tools report what happened. Branch connects experiences and measures why conversions happened by preserving context across journeys. We’re obsessed with what our customers have done 82% Reduction in fraudulent installs 180% Revenue Growth 85% Increase in App Installs 650% App Revenue Growth 26% Increase in YOY Retention 3X Higher App Engagement And they say it better than we do “By using Branch as a mobile measurement partner and linking platform, we can better understand which sources are driving the highest return and most efficient cost per install while simultaneously removing friction from our digital guest experience.” Shannon Reilly Senior Manager, Lifecycle Marketing, Shake Shack “Deep linking has turned our emails into a powerful channel to drive both app engagement and bottom line results. Branch’s Universal Email powers our best-performing campaigns, driving a 6% click-to-order rate and a 30% app engagement rate.” Max Mullen Co-founder, Instacart “Branch’s Journeys gave us the freedom to A/B test multiple campaigns, creatives, and CTA, with no dev effort for our 36 countries.” Fabio Hanashiro Marketing Consultant, Jora “Engineers are often skeptical of SDKs, and I’ve been consistently impressed with Branch quality of the entire engineering ecosystem and the support they provide to me and my team.” Jason van Der Merwe Head of Engineering, Growth, Strava “Branch lets us deliver personalized experiences to our customers with the right promo at the right time and with the right spend via multiple channels and respective attributions. This is truly crucial for us and our goals of establishing the Domino’s Indonesia app as the go-to for customers.” Harneet Singh CEO, Domino's Pizza Indonesia Scaling across the globe 2,000+ technology partners 3 billion+ worldwide users 100,000+ customer brands (and counting) Where we operate: Headquarters: United States Regional hubs across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific Customers supported globally with regional expertise #WeAreBranch We hear time and time again that the beauty of Branch is in the people. We’re passionate about the work we do, the team we do it with, and the customers we do it for. We chase big ideas, focus on work that matters, and boldly take smart risks. Take your shot Hustle with heart Crush it together FAQ What is an MMP? A mobile measurement partner (MMP) helps you measure marketing impact across channels by attributing installs, opens, and downstream events to the campaigns and touchpoints that drove them. How does Branch attribution work? Branch uses multiple attribution methods prioritized by accuracy to determine which marketing touchpoint influenced an install or app open, then ties downstream events back to that source so teams can optimize spend and outcomes. See the Help Center overview for more details. Does Branch support deep linking? Yes. Branch deep links route users to the right in-app content or web destination, preserve context, and reduce drop-off when customers move between web, app, email, social, and ads. Learn more . Can Branch measure web, app, email, QR codes, and offline journeys? Yes. Branch supports omnichannel linking and measurement across web to app, app to web, email, paid media, QR codes, and offline-to-online handoffs so teams can see the full journey. Learn more . Does Branch support privacy-first measurement? Branch supports modern privacy frameworks and measurement approaches to maintain coverage as platforms and regulations evolve. See our security overview . Can Branch help with CTV and TV-driven journeys? Branch helps connect offline and TV-style moments to digital experiences through links and QR codes, making it easier to quantify downstream impact. How does Branch help with AI-powered discovery and agents? Branch is built for emerging discovery surfaces by preserving context and measurement when traffic originates from AI-powered answers, assistants, and agents, including journeys where conversions may be completed by humans or machines. What integrations does Branch offer? Branch works across a large partner ecosystem. Browse our partner directory . How secure is Branch? Branch maintains enterprise-grade security and privacy practices designed for strict procurement and compliance environments, including: – SOC 2-compliant infrastructure – GDPR- and CCPA-aligned data practices – Reliable links that persist across OS updates and device changes – Highly available global infrastructure with low latency Learn more Do I need an SDK to use Branch? Some Branch capabilities require an SDK for in-app measurement, while others such as links, QR codes, and web journeys can be implemented without one. Does Branch support SKAdNetwork and privacy-safe attribution? Yes. Branch supports SKAdNetwork (SKAN) and privacy-safe measurement approaches designed for modern mobile ecosystems. What data can I export from Branch? Branch allows teams to export raw and aggregated data to analytics, BI, and warehouse tools for deeper analysis and reporting. Let’s get growing Whether you’re looking to unlock smarter growth or build the next generation of connected experiences, Branch is here to help. acceptedAnswer.text: A mobile measurement partner (MMP) helps you measure marketing impact across channels by attributing installs, opens, and downstream events to the campaigns and touchpoints that drove them.

Branch uses multiple attribution methods prioritized by accuracy to determine which marketing touchpoint influenced an install or app open, then ties downstream events back to that source so teams can optimize spend and outcomes. See the Help Center overview for more details.
Yes. Branch deep links route users to the right in-app content or web destination, preserve context, and reduce drop-off when customers move between web, app, email, social, and ads. Learn more.

jsonld_parsed.name: Can Branch measure web, app, email, QR codes, and offline journeys?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Branch supports omnichannel linking and measurement across web to app, app to web, email, paid media, QR codes, and offline-to-online handoffs so teams can see the full journey. Learn more.
Branch supports modern privacy frameworks and measurement approaches to maintain coverage as platforms and regulations evolve. See our security overview.

jsonld_parsed.name: Can Branch help with CTV and TV-driven journeys?

acceptedAnswer.text: Branch helps connect offline and TV-style moments to digital experiences through links and QR codes, making it easier to quantify downstream impact.

jsonld_parsed.name: How does Branch help with AI-powered discovery and agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Branch is built for emerging discovery surfaces by preserving context and measurement when traffic originates from AI-powered answers, assistants, and agents, including journeys where conversions may be completed by humans or machines.
Branch works across a large partner ecosystem. Browse our partner directory.

Branch maintains enterprise-grade security and privacy practices designed for strict procurement and compliance environments, including:

- SOC 2-compliant infrastructure
- GDPR- and CCPA-aligned data practices
- Reliable links that persist across OS updates and device changes
- Highly available global infrastructure with low latency

Learn more

jsonld_parsed.name: Do I need an SDK to use Branch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some Branch capabilities require an SDK for in-app measurement, while others such as links, QR codes, and web journeys can be implemented without one.

jsonld_parsed.name: Does Branch support SKAdNetwork and privacy-safe attribution?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Branch supports SKAdNetwork (SKAN) and privacy-safe measurement approaches designed for modern mobile ecosystems.

jsonld_parsed.name: What data can I export from Branch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Branch allows teams to export raw and aggregated data to analytics, BI, and warehouse tools for deeper analysis and reporting.
